lines.text: My smart speaker says I'm never alone here.
I moved in an hour ago. The attic door is open.
So I opened the speaker's voice history.
Hundreds of recordings. Every day at 5:12 PM.
lines.say: Hundreds of recordings. Every day at five twelve P.M.

lines.text: The first one is from 2019. Years before I came.
lines.say: The first one is from twenty nineteen. Years before I came.

lines.text: I pressed play. It was MY voice.
And an old woman answered: Yes, dear. Right here.
Every recording. Same question. Same answer.
Then I found the newest one.

lines.say: It was dated tomorrow. Five twelve P.M.

lines.text: I pressed play. And heard myself scream.
Above me, something climbed down the ladder.
And the speaker whispered: Now two people are home.
